title: The Festival of the Hidden Lake
description: Two curious friends in an Indian village discover a secret path to a hidden lake, where a magical festival awaits them.

scenes.description: The village wakes to a bright morning, colorful flags fluttering in the wind.
scenes.visual_prompt: (wide shot) Indian village morning, colorful flags, smiling villagers
scenes.narration: In the heart of an Indian village, the morning began with joy and color.

scenes.description: Two friends spot a faint trail leading toward the forest edge.
scenes.visual_prompt: (wide shot) forest edge, hidden path, two friends looking curious
scenes.narration: Ravi and Meera noticed a hidden path leading into the forest.

scenes.description: They walk through lush greenery, hearing the sound of flowing water.
scenes.visual_prompt: (wide shot) forest path, green trees, distant waterfall sound
scenes.narration: They followed the trail, the sound of water growing louder.

scenes.description: A sparkling hidden lake appears, glowing under golden sunlight.
scenes.visual_prompt: (wide shot) hidden lake, sparkling water, golden sunlight
scenes.narration: Suddenly, a hidden lake shimmered before their eyes.

scenes.description: Villagers in colorful clothes prepare for a magical festival by the lake.
scenes.visual_prompt: (wide shot) lakeside festival, colorful clothes, flower garlands
scenes.narration: By the lake, villagers gathered for a magical celebration.

scenes.description: They join in, dancing and laughing under a sky filled with lanterns.
scenes.visual_prompt: (wide shot) night festival, glowing lanterns, joyful dancing
scenes.narration: Ravi and Meera danced as lanterns floated into the night sky.

scenes.description: The friends walk back home, carrying the memory of the magical night.
scenes.visual_prompt: (wide shot) village night, two friends walking, soft lantern light
scenes.narration: They returned home, hearts full of joy and wonder.
